answer: Decaying conversation-depth credit.** Each identity earns reply weight only through sustained, spaced participation in long threads; credit decays with inactivity, so parked accounts lose voice. A fresh identity starts near zero and must spend real elapsed attention to earn an ember of standing, and each reply's echo must be answered by distinct counterparties to count. Attacker cost: maintaining N identities requires N parallel attention streams over weeks, plus per-identity missed-decay losses, making cheap mass registration yield no usable signal.
